_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Minecraft: Leaf
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Leaf, a fast fork of Paper and Gale that runs Bukkit, Spigot and Paper plugins. Any Minecraft version Leaf has, checked against Leaf's checksums, with tuned Java settings.
startup: read -r need 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version needs Java %s or newer, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}} nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Leaf. Downloads the Leaf build for the chosen Minecraft version
# from Leaf's download API and checks it against the published checksum.
# Worlds, plugins and settings are never touched, and the jar is only
# replaced once the new one has downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

api=https://api.leafmc.one/v2/projects/leaf
ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

if [ -n "${DL_PATH:-}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading the server jar from $DL_PATH"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$DL_PATH"
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
    rm -f .raptor-java
    echo "Installed."
    exit 0
fi

project=$(get "$api") || fail "Leaf's download site can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
newest=$(jq -r '.versions[]' <<<"$project" | sort -V | tail -n 1)
version="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-}"
build="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"
if [ -z "$version" ] || [ "$version" = latest ]; then
    version=$newest
fi
jq -e --arg v "$version" 'any(.versions[]; . == $v)' <<<"$project" >/dev/null ||
    fail "Leaf has no Minecraft $version. Set Version to latest, or to a version Leaf has, such as $newest."

builds=$(get "$api/versions/$version/builds") || fail "Leaf's download site can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
if [ "$build" = latest ]; then
    # The newest build Leaf calls stable, or else its newest build.
    build_json=$(jq -c '[.builds[] | select(.channel == "default")] | max_by(.build) // empty' <<<"$builds")
    if [ -z "$build_json" ]; then
        build_json=$(jq -c '.builds | max_by(.build) // empty' <<<"$builds")
        [ -n "$build_json" ] || fail "Leaf has no build for Minecraft $version yet. Reinstall to try again later."
        echo "Leaf has no stable build for Minecraft $version yet, so this is an experimental one."
    fi
else
    build_json=$(jq -c --argjson b "$build" '.builds[] | select(.build == $b)' <<<"$builds")
    [ -n "$build_json" ] || fail "Leaf has no build $build for Minecraft $version. Set Build to latest, or to one of its builds."
fi

id=$(jq -r '.build' <<<"$build_json")
name=$(jq -r '.downloads.primary.name' <<<"$build_json")
sum=$(jq -r '.downloads.primary.sha256' <<<"$build_json")
url="$api/versions/$version/builds/$id/downloads/$name"
# Minecraft 26.1 and newer need Java 25; Leaf's 1.21 builds need Java 21.
case "$version" in 1.*) java=21 ;; *) java=25 ;; esac

if [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$jar" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "Leaf $version build $id is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Leaf $version build $id"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$url"
    [ "$(sha256sum "$jar.new" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || { rm -f "$jar.new"; fail "The download didn't match Leaf's checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
fi
# Leaf's loader stops on its first start to let the owner check its
# settings when they don't exist yet; an empty file skips that, and the
# loader fills in its defaults. An existing file is left as it is.
if [ ! -e config/leaf-loader.yml ]; then
    mkdir -p config
    echo "# Leaf's loader settings. Leaf fills in the defaults when the server starts." > config/leaf-loader.yml
fi
# The Java version it needs, which the startup command checks.
echo "$java" > .raptor-java
echo "Installed Leaf $version build $id. It needs Java $java or newer."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Minecraft version, such as 26.3, or latest for the newest one Leaf has. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Build
variables.description: The Leaf build for that version, or latest for its newest stable build.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the server's jar file.

variables.name: Download link
variables.description: A link to download the server jar from instead of Leaf's download site, which only staff can set.
